name: pinched-boss
why: A hole crossing a boss's side: where circles of radius 3.5 and 1.5, 2 sqrt 2 apart, cross, the material between them closes at acos(0.61905) = 51.753 degrees, a feather along both crossing lines. A sweep read 0.042 at 200 samples and 0.0033 at 6000 here, and on the control box, where the grille cut its screw boss this way, found it 4 times in 10 at 0.144 to 0.41. The edge search reports 0 at the closed-form angle.
